response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong fundamentals, testing discipline, and DevOps/CI exposure, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. Hands-on C++ is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus an academic project, versus the 5–10 years of Windows C++ required, and the primary stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle work, and no fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain experience; RIDE Capital offers only tangential fintech exposure. Strong communication skills and a rapid-learning track record are evident, but the gap on the non-negotiable technical and domain criteria is too wide for this consulting engagement.
strengths: Broad senior-level experience with high-performance, low-latency systems
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, tooling
Excellent communication — public talks, workshops, courses
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++, none on Windows recently
No SQL Server/Oracle depth; SQL listed but not demonstrated
No fixed income or capital-markets domain experience
